title: Adaptive Learning launch fix
changes: Fixed the v11.4.0 startup error that prevented main-page buttons from being wired.
Restored hidden compatibility elements expected by the existing app.js while keeping Village view unavailable.
Forces Classic Activity Landmarks and the Practice Hub visible immediately, including for users whose saved setting previously selected Village view.
Retains all v11.4.0 Adaptive Learning features: word states, adaptive missions, mistake repair, Campfire Recall and Kotoba Rain.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.4.1.
